meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 项目装上 DeltaChat 渠道后,机器人通过邮箱收发消息(端到端加密),可把它接入 agent,支持一对一私聊与群聊,并能收发文件附件。
howto.when: 当你要把 DeltaChat 作为新渠道加入项目、配置机器人邮箱,并让 agent 接管 DeltaChat 私聊或群聊时。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 DeltaChat 渠道
say.note: 拉取 channels 分支的适配器并安装依赖

say.text: 给 DeltaChat 的私聊接一个 agent
把这个 DeltaChat 群接到某个 agent 组
say.note: 用 /manage-channels 或 ncl 接线

howto.what_en: After install, your NanoClaw project gains a DeltaChat channel: the bot sends and receives messages over email with end-to-end encryption, and its DMs or groups can be wired to an agent, with file attachments both ways.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add DeltaChat as a channel to the project, configure the bot's email account, and let an agent handle its DeltaChat DMs or groups.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to my project
say_en.note: Fetches the channels branch adapter and installs the pinned package

say_en.text: Wire an agent to my DeltaChat DM
say_en.note: Runs /init-first-agent to create and wire the agent

say_en.text: Connect this DeltaChat group to an agent group
say_en.note: Use /manage-channels or ncl to wire it
